The City at the Center of AI
videos.description: Anthropic’s record-setting IPO is expected to make many of its employees rich, and other AI companies may be next. The flood of investment into the technology could be the largest, quickest, and most concentrated wealth creation event in history. And at the center of this modern gold rush is San Francisco, a city used to booms and busts – but never at this scale. The Anthropic IPO Is Adding to a Real Estate Frenzy in Major Tech Hubs: https://bloom.bg/4j0PmXk Lenders eager to embrace AI wealth are turning private-company stakes into cash spending power in cities such as San Francisco, New York and Miami. videos.title: Rep. Stutzman: GOP Must Finish Strong in Lame Duck
videos.description: Republican Representative Marlin Stutzman of Indiana criticized GOP lawmakers for missing votes as the party races to finish its agenda before losing the House majority, telling absent colleagues to “get back to work.” He also pointed to unfinished business on spending, defense, permitting and the debt ceiling. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video?
